context: Monday morning, office cafeteria. Daichi is hungover; Kenji is unreasonably cheerful.
purpose: morning-after banter — friend solidarity through teasing

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Light, knowing tone. Gentle ribbing wrapped in real concern. Sets a cup of water down with a soft clink—casual care.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 生きとらん。本当に、生きとらん。
lines.en: Not really. Honestly—I'm running on fumes.
lines.style: Flat, defeated. Head drops onto the table in the voice. Heavy Kansai dialect, the words dragging with exhaustion and theatrical despair.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 水、飲み。今日、午後会議やで。
lines.en: Drink that water. You've got an afternoon meeting, remember.
lines.style: Half-suppressed laugh underneath. Switches to rough Kansai for the last phrase—playful imitation, clearly teasing him.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: やめてや、お前。本当に、やめてや。
lines.en: Come on, don't do this. I'm serious—don't.
lines.style: Wounded performance, voice cracking theatrically on the protest. Mock-suffering with genuine affection buried underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 大丈夫やって、時間あるから。寝とき、少し。
lines.en: You'll survive—you've got time. Just grab a few minutes of sleep.
lines.style: Warm and steady, like a real hand on the shoulder. Underneath the humor: genuine friendship. Matter-of-fact reassurance.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Quiet, mumbled, stripped of all the earlier performance. Real gratitude breaking through. The softest moment he's allowed himself all morning.
